Using the equation of motion with drag \(F_D = k v^2\):

\[
m v \frac{dv}{dh} = mg - k v^2
\]

Integrating from \(v=0\) to \(v=0.95v_t\):

\[
h = \frac{m}{2k} \ln\left(\frac{v_t^2}{v_t^2 - (0.95v_t)^2}\right)
= \frac{m}{2k} \ln\left(\frac{1}{1 - 0.95^2}\right)
\]

\[
h = \frac{80}{2(0.27)} \ln\left(\frac{1}{0.0975}\right)
\approx 344.87 \text{ m}
\]

ANSWER: 344.87
